description:
This is a remote position.
About Sentient
Sentient is the only nonprofit, nonpartisan news organization solely focused on factory farms and their effects on climate, animals, workers, clean water, public health and rural communities.
Founded in 2018, Sentient's content is fact-checked and science-driven, with reporting that serves readers-especially those in frontline rural communities-interested in the impacts of what they eat on animals, climate, water and their local economy.
Over the last twelve months, Sentient has been building the Food and Farming Journalism Network (FFJN), now home to more than 350 freelance and staff journalists across 48 countries covering factory farming, agriculture, climate, labor and food systems. FFJN provides expert trainings, reporting resources, fact-check and sourcing support, networking events, beat dinners and regular newsletters designed to help journalists deepen their coverage of industrial animal agriculture.
With new grant funding, Sentient is launching a two-year pilot, the Food and Farming Storytelling Fund, to grow the media ecosystem around factory farming by supporting trusted journalists, creators and independent communicators, and by piloting collaborations with credible influencers to translate Sentient's reporting for new audiences.
Position Overview
The Program Manager will lead the Food and Farming Storytelling Fund through the two-year pilot program designed to support independent journalists telling stories on factory farming. This role oversees direct reporting grants to journalists and works with the FFJN Manager to grow FFJN into a stronger, more sustainable media ecosystem around factory farming issues.
The Program Manager will supervise the FFJN Manager and report to senior leadership.
This is a full-time, two-year W-2 employee position tied to the length of the funded pilot, with the possibility of extension if funding is renewed. This is a remote, work-from-home role open to U.S. based candidates compatible with the Eastern timezone.
Key Responsibilities
Network Leadership & Journalist Support

• Identify and recruit 5-10 trusted journalists and/or independent communicators to receive direct reporting grants, supporting them in dedicating at least 50% of their output to factory farming and food systems coverage.

• Provide editorial mentorship and communications strategy advising to grantees.

• Oversee trainings, workshops, fact-check/sourcing support and networking events, including beat dinners, for FFJN members.

Program Growth & Distribution

• Support the launch or expansion of independent media platforms among FFJN members, including Substacks, newsletters, podcasts and creator-led channels.

• Oversee publishing, syndication and cross-platform distribution efforts to expand the reach of supported reporting.

• Lead network growth and audience-development initiatives, including trainings on sustainable audience-building and creator-led journalism models.

Measurement & Reporting

• Track and report on program outputs and impact, including audience reach and engagement, sentiment analysis and narrative penetration (republication, follow-on coverage) across supported journalism and creator content.

• Contribute to grant reporting and impact tracking for funders.

• Manage the program budget, tools/subscriptions, and workflow/CRM systems used to track creators and grantees.

Team Management

• Supervise the FFJN Manager, delegating community-management, logistics and administrative tasks.

Requirements

• Proven experience managing journalist networks, fellowship programs or similar media/communications initiatives.

• Strong understanding of the freelance journalism, newsletter/Substack, podcast and creator-economy landscape.

• Experience with grant-making, grantee management or program administration.

• Excellent relationship-building skills with journalists, editors, creators and influencers.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage

title: Construction - Change Management Specialist
description:
Position Summary
The Change Management Specialist is responsible for identifying, documenting, pricing, tracking, negotiating, and closing changes to masonry contract scope throughout the project lifecycle. This position plays a critical role in protecting the company’s contractual rights and ensuring that additional work, deleted work, delays, and impacts are properly documented and converted into approved change orders.
Working closely with project managers, estimators, superintendents, foremen, accounting personnel, general contractors, architects, engineers, and owners, the Change Management Specialist will review project documents and field conditions to identify changes that may affect the masonry contractor’s scope, cost, schedule, or productivity.
The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of commercial masonry construction and can connect changes in drawings and field conditions to measurable impacts in labor, materials, equipment, schedule, and project cost.
Key Responsibilities
Change Identification

• Monitor architectural, structural, and project documents for changes affecting masonry scope.

• Review revised drawings, specifications, addenda, RFIs, ASIs, bulletins, architect’s instructions, and field directives.

• Identify additions, deletions, substitutions, revisions, and clarifications that may constitute changes to the masonry contract.

• Review field conditions and identify work that differs from the original contract documents.

• Identify potential changes resulting from unforeseen conditions, design revisions, coordination issues, access restrictions, sequencing changes, and other project impacts.

• Review RFI responses for changes or clarifications that may affect cost or schedule.

• Work with project managers and field personnel to ensure potential changes are identified as early as possible.
Change Documentation

• Maintain a comprehensive change-order log for assigned projects.

• Document the source, date, description, and potential impact of each change.

• Maintain supporting documentation including drawings, photographs, correspondence, RFIs, meeting minutes, daily reports, delivery records, and field documentation.

• Ensure changes are properly documented before additional work is performed whenever contract requirements allow.

• Develop clear and traceable records connecting each change to the resulting cost and schedule impact.

• Maintain organized records of submitted, approved, rejected, pending, and disputed changes.
Change Order Pricing

• Prepare detailed change-order pricing for masonry work.

• Develop labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and other cost estimates associated with changes.

• Quantify additional or deleted masonry quantities.

• Calculate impacts associated with CMU, brick, stone, mortar, reinforcing, flashing, lintels, embeds, scaffolding, equipment, and other masonry-related materials and activities.

• Evaluate labor productivity and additional labor requirements resulting from changes.

• Account for applicable overhead, supervision, general conditions, insurance, bonds, and profit in accordance with company and contract requirements.

• Obtain pricing and supporting information from vendors and subcontractors when necessary.

• Coordinate pricing with estimators and project managers to ensure consistency with project requirements.
Contract & Scope Review

• Review masonry subcontracts, purchase orders, project specifications, drawings, and scope documents.

• Develop a strong understanding of contractual requirements related to changes, notices, pricing, and documentation.

• Compare original contract documents against revised documents to determine scope changes.

• Identify work that falls outside the original masonry contract scope.

• Assist project management in determining entitlement to additional compensation.

• Identify notice requirements and deadlines associated with potential changes.

• Escalate significant contractual or commercial iss

title: C++ Software Engineer - Core Trading Technology
description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology- and data-driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high-quality returns for our investors.

You will join the Core Trading Platform team, which is responsible for the design and operation of QRT’s global electronic trading infrastructure. This team builds and maintains the ultra-low latency systems that underpin real-time trading, managing performance-critical workflows across global markets. You will work closely with developers, traders, and operations to optimise system behaviour, reduce latency, and ensure platform reliability at scale.

 

Your future role within QRT

• Design and implement low-latency trading systems on Linux, focused on throughput, reliability, and determinism

• Engineer scalable, high-performance distributed systems that support global real-time trading workflows

• Analyse system behaviour using low-level tools such as packet captures, core dumps, and runtime profilers

• Apply deep expertise in TCP, UDP, and multicast to understanding trade-offs in short-haul vs long-haul networks

• Continuously profile, benchmark, and optimise code to reduce latency and increase throughput

• Engage across the full software lifecycle: from architecture to debugging in live trading environments

 

Your present skillset

• 2+ years of professional C++/C development experience on Linux, including modern C++ and multithreading

• Strong expertise in TCP, UDP, multicast, and performance trade-offs in low-latency networks

• Experience building and operating high-throughput distributed systems in production

• Familiarity with scalable I/O models (e.g., epoll, io_uring), lock-free structures, and concurrent programming

• Deep attention to detail with a rigorous approach to performance troubleshooting and optimisation

• Proficiency in system-level tools (e.g., gdb, perf, tcpdump, valgrind, wireshark)

• Comfortable working autonomously and taking ownership from problem to solution

• Scripting experience (e.g., Python, Bash) and exposure to CI/CD or observability tooling is a plus

• Prior exposure to electronic trading or exchange-facing systems is advantageous

 

 

Base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $220,000 per year.  

QRT Total Compensation includes discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

We're hiring a dedicated in-house Senior Product Designer - someone who thinks in systems, ships polished UI, and can translate complex product capabilities into compelling visual stories. You’ll be embedded across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales - the single design partner who helps the business win in the market. You’ll lean heavily on AI tools to operate at the scale of a much larger design function.

Location & Work Style

• Fully remote, based anywhere in APAC or the GCC (we'll consider candidates in time zones from GMT+3 to GMT+10).

Key Responsibilities

Product (UI/UX)

• Own end-to-end UI/UX for the Pulse iD platform: discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, handoff.

• Build and maintain our Figma design system, components and tokens so design and engineering can ship faster.

• Partner with Product and Engineering on dashboards, configuration tools, merchant- and partner-facing portals, consumer-facing experiences embedded in bank, fintech and telco apps, and our new retail media surfaces.

• Use AI tools (ie: Claude Design) to spin up rapid prototypes before finalising in Figma.

Visual Storytelling & Product Communication

• Experience in a product-led tech start-up or SaaS environment; regulated industry (fintech, banking, telco) experience is a strong plus.

• Track record of being the sole designer in a small team - comfortable owning everything from strategy to pixel-pushing without an art director above you.

• Confident in motion design - you can take a concept from storyboard to delivered animation without external help for short-form videos.

• Strong typographic, layout and visual systems sensibility - your decks and one-pagers look like they belong to a serious B2B brand.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English; able to present and defend design decisions to senior stakeholders.

AI-first ways of working

Working style

• Highly organised and self-managing; comfortable juggling product roadmap work and last-minute sales / marketing requests.

• Pragmatic and outcome-oriented - you ship, iterate and prioritise ruthlessly.

• Collaborative and low-ego; happy to take feedback from Product, Sales, Marketing and the CEO, and synthesise it into great work.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here - and it’s what will make our future. Every large organisation is investing in data, analytics and AI to serve customers better. Most hit the same wall. The same person appears multiple times across systems that don't talk to each other. Relationships stay hidden - from families and social groups to corporate hierarchies and supply chains. The data is there, but it's fragmented, inconsistent and stripped of context, so nobody quite trusts what it says. You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. We listen to what banks, insurers and public sector organisations really need. We shape the proposition around it. Then we make sure clients, partners and colleagues can see the value. The reach is unusual: our product roadmap, our go-to-market strategy and the conversations we have in the market all start here. Complex problems, senior audiences, commercial consequence. Ready?

title: Remote Care Navigator - VA Benefits Experience Required
description:
Care Navigation and Benefits Specialist - Remote
If you know the VA system well enough that colleagues have turned to you when a Veteran's situation became complicated, this opportunity may be worth a conversation.
We're looking for an experienced care navigation professional who can bring that knowledge to a growing Veteran-focused care coordination program. You'll help Veterans navigate healthcare, benefits, behavioral health services, community resources, and other support while also helping the broader care team handle complex cases more effectively.
What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to do more than manage individual cases. You'll serve as a resource to other care coordinators, help improve Veteran-specific workflows, identify gaps in the program, contribute to training, and help shape how care coordination is delivered as the program develops.
The Experience That Matters Most
We're particularly interested in someone whose background brings together Veteran or VA experience, care coordination, and increasing program responsibility .
You'll need:

• 5+ years of experience as a clinical social worker, care coordinator, care navigator, or in a similar field, with demonstrated progressive program management experience

• Direct experience working with Veterans and/or within the VA system

• 1+ years of experience working successfully in a remote environment

• Knowledge of VA healthcare, Veteran benefits and resources, behavioral health, and social determinants of health

• Experience supporting medically and/or behaviorally complex populations

• Experience documenting cases within a care management or electronic health record system

• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills

Experience with motivational interviewing is also important.
A social work license is not required , although candidates with credentials such as an LMSW or similar professional background are encouraged to apply. Fluent Spanish is helpful but is not required .
How You'll Make an Impact
You'll help Veterans understand and navigate available resources, including VA healthcare, benefits, community care, and other services that address healthcare and social needs.
You'll also guide complex Veteran cases, help determine appropriate referrals and escalations, and step in with direct Veteran support when specialized assistance is needed.
Beyond individual cases, you'll help develop Veteran-specific care coordination workflows, identify opportunities to improve the program, and work with care coordination and training leadership to strengthen the team's understanding of VA healthcare, benefits navigation, Veteran resources, and common barriers to care.
In short, your experience will help both the Veteran in front of you and the team supporting the Veterans who come next.
Location, Schedule and Compensation
This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week remote position working Monday through Friday during normal Central Time business hours.
Candidates must reside in the Central Time Zone in Texas, Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana, or Tennessee and have a dedicated home-office environment.
The anticipated salary range is $80,000 to $100,000 , with potential flexibility based on the selected candidate's experience and background.
Travel is not required.
If you've spent several years helping Veterans navigate complex healthcare or benefit systems and you're ready for a position where that experience can influence a broader program, we'd like to talk with you.

title: (fluent English) Freelance Recruitment Specialist (Global, remotely)

description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Baseten's Compute org is in hyper growth. As it scales, the systems and workflows that keep supply and demand balanced across our GPU fleet need to get more sophisticated, and this role exists to make sure they do.

Compute sits at the center of how Baseten allocates, forecasts, and manages the capacity that powers every customer inference request. The team that supports this work, C3, runs on a mix of internal tooling, manual processes, and systems that haven't fully kept pace with the scale of the problem. This role exists to close that gap.

You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered workflows that give the Compute and C3 teams real leverage, automating the manual, repetitive, and error-prone parts of the capacity lifecycle so the team can focus on judgment calls that actually need a human. We want someone who can walk in, audit what exists today, identify what's missing or broken, and start shipping fast.

You know when to reach for an existing internal tool and when to build something custom in Claude Code. You think two to three steps ahead about how the thing you build today fits into the broader capacity systems architecture tomorrow. And you bring a point of view on our stack, on what we should be building, and on where AI can do something existing tooling simply can't.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Ship AI-powered workflows for Compute and C3: build the agents and automations that give capacity analysts, ops leads, and engineers real leverage, off-loading manual and repetitive work like data pipeline cleanup, migration troubleshooting, and capacity investigation.

- Get insights in front of the team: turn fleet utilization, allocation, and demand-forecasting data into the dashboards, alerts, and recommendations that C3 and Compute leadership actually act on. A build isn't done until the team is using it.

- Audit the stack and generate your own backlog: Compute runs on a mix of tooling with real overlap and real gaps. Walk in with a point of view, identify what's missing or broken, and prioritize without waiting to be handed a roadmap.

- Ship team-productivity workflows fast: triage asks from Supply, Demand, and C3, find the low-hanging fruit, and build it. A good week looks like an ops lead asking for something Monday and having it live by Wednesday.

- Know when to go custom: not everything belongs in a point-and-click tool. Spin up bespoke AI-powered solutions in Claude Code when the problem calls for it, and make that call with judgment, not default.

- Think in systems, not solutions: every workflow you build has upstream and downstream implications across Supply, Demand, and Engineering. Anticipate them, design for them, and don't create technical debt someone else has to unwind six months later.

- Integrate third-party APIs and internal systems to sync events and information across disparate tools: ensuring data flows reliably between C3, the CRM, and the systems Compute depends on every day.

- Document what you build: if people can't find it, understand it, or trust it, it doesn't matter how well it works.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of experience in AI/automation engineering, workflow automation, or a technical operations role, ideally at a high-growth, AI-native infrastructure or B2B company

- You've shipped production agents on Vercel. Build custom internal apps and agents on Vercel, with durable workflows

• Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills

• Ability to obtain and maintain the required clearance for this role

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Liquidity Platform team powers the core infrastructure that enables Airwallex to manage funds efficiently, securely and intelligently across the globe.

Our platform ensures that money is always in the right place, at the right time, and used in the most effective way. We build systems for liquidity management, safeguarding, investment, and cash data management and analysis. These capabilities are critical to supporting Airwallex’s global operations, regulatory obligations and capital efficiency.

As Airwallex continues to scale globally, liquidity becomes one of the most important and complex infrastructure challenges. We need to forecast funding needs, optimize cash movements, support safeguarding compliance across jurisdictions, improve investment capabilities, and uncover new opportunities for capital optimization through high-quality data and analytics.

We are looking for talented and driven backend engineers to join the Liquidity Platform team and help us build one of the world’s most advanced and efficient liquidity management systems.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You are an experienced backend engineer who is comfortable working in complex domains like financial markets, payments or other high-integrity distributed systems. You care deeply about correctness, simplicity and operability, and you’re happy to engage with product and non-technical stakeholders on trade-offs.

You’re pragmatic: you can balance ideal architectures with the realities of delivery, and you’re comfortable iterating on systems that are already in production.

This role is based in Singapore.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Praxis is hiring a Director, Clinical Systems & Data. You would lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the clinical systems and data capabilities that support Praxis’s clinical development and study operations. - Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

- Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

ENABLE TEAMS TO KEEP THE QUALITY BAR HIGH

- Rotating around different product teams for short periods to level up quality

- Define and evolve the pragmatic test pyramid for our products - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where testing belongs in faster layers (unit and component tests)

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across our products

- Devise and set up performance benchmarks to ensure critical parts of our systems don't regress

 

BRING AI TESTING INTO THE SDLC

- Speed up our SDLC by building agents that exploratory test changes and catch issues before they get to production

- Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes

Marketing is Preply's primary financial lever, and this Finance role sits at its core. Reporting to the Director of FP&A and partnering closely with Preply's Growth team, you'll shape the frameworks we use to determine marketing spend and evaluate return on investment. This is a senior ownership role: you'll interpret analyses from our marketing analytics teams, evaluate current trends, and translate strategic plans from Growth and Brand Marketing into near-term and long-term spend and user acquisition forecasts. You'll own the financial narrative, regularly presenting results and recommendations to senior executives, while analyzing key drivers, risks, and opportunities through comprehensive sensitivity analysis. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Geo expansion - Size new market opportunities, build the investment case, set the return thresholds that make a market worth entering, and track performance against strategic thesis.

- Business partnership & reporting - Act as a trusted Finance partner to the Growth team; translate complex analysis into actionable recommendations for the VP of Growth, COO, and CFO; pressure-test the financial logic behind major marketing initiatives.

- AI workflow integration - Use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, research, and model development.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

- 8+ years in marketing analytics, growth analytics, performance marketing, or Finance roles closely partnered with these functions, with demonstrated deep domain knowledge in marketing.

- Strong fluency in key marketing metrics and concepts: incrementality, marginal CAC, LTV, retention curves, payback periods, geo-lift/holdout testing, media mix modeling, attribution, and channel efficiency.

- Experience at a high-growth B2C marketplace or subscription business.

- A clear, concise communicator capable of presenting and defending recommendations before executive leadership.

- A proven track record of influencing Growth teams and building operational frameworks that accelerate performance.

- Fluency with Looker, Snowflake/SQL, and advanced Sheets/Excel.

- Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to accelerate analysis and surface insights.

- Proven financial modeling capability, or a strong analytical foundation with the ability to master comp

The ideal candidate will have strong practical experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog, along with a solid understanding of modern data architecture patterns such as the medallion architecture and structured streaming. • Monitor and troubleshoot data processing jobs, implementing data quality checks and observability to ensure high availability.

• Document data processes, frameworks, pipelines, and data mappings for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Work closely with scrum teams, product owners, and client stakeholders to deliver end-to-end data solutions.

• Stay current on Databricks platform capabilities and industry trends to recommend best-fit tools and technologies.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up. 

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach.

What You'll Do

• Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out. 

• Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all.

• Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures.

• Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off.

• As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team.

What You'll Bring

• 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment

• Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports

• A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there

• Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them

• Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales

• Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel

• You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature.

• You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency.

• You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters.

• You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought.

title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Mansfield
description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Mansfield
Job Location: Work at Home, Ohio, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)
